description: One job with its home address and, when it was converted from a request, that request. A field worker gets not found unless they are assigned to a visit on it. A lead also gets a job their crew is on. Notes on the job are notes_list and notes_add (target_kind job, target_id this job_id), not fields on this result.
name: jobs_get

next_actions.description: Up to 3 useful next steps, best first, in plain words. op names the op to call, when there is one. when is now, later, check, or tell_human. due_at is set for later and check when there is a natural time. A send is tell_human: show the owner the draft, then send only when they say so.
